altergeistmemorygant.name: Altergeist Memorygant
altergeistmemorygant.desc:
2+ "Altergeist" monsters
During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other monster; this card gains ATK equal to that Tributed monster's ATK on the field. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, this card can make a second attack in a row. If this card would be destroyed, you can banish 1 monster from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Altergeist Memorygant" once per turn.

bigtuskedmammoth.name: Big-Tusked Mammoth
bigtuskedmammoth.desc: Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.

candelatothebeastoflight.name: Candelato, the Beast of Light
candelatothebeastoflight.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Phantom Beast" card.)
Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Candelato, the Beast of Light" once per turn. You can discard 2 other cards; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that has a coin tossing effect. When a card or effect is activated that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect.

chroniclemagician.name: Chronicle Magician
chroniclemagician.desc: If a monster(s) with 2500 original ATK or DEF is Normal or Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Dark Magician" or "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in your Monster Zone; it gains 2500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Chronicle Magician" once per turn.

cosmiccyclone.name: Cosmic Cyclone
cosmiccyclone.desc: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; banish it.

darksimorgh.name: Dark Simorgh
darksimorgh.desc: While face-up on the field, this card is also WIND-Attribute. You can banish 1 DARK monster and 1 WIND monster from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can banish 1 DARK monster and 1 WIND monster from your hand; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. Your opponent cannot Set any cards on the field.

dragonice.name: Dragon Ice
dragonice.desc: When your opponent Special Summons a monster (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand or Graveyard. There can only be 1 "Dragon Ice" on the field.

dragunityknightgaebulg.name: Dragunity Knight - Gae Bulg
dragunityknightgaebulg.desc:
1 Dragon-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Winged Beast-Type monsters 
 If this card attacks or is attacked, during the Damage Step you can remove from play 1 (only) Winged Beast-Type monster from your Graveyard, to have this card gain the ATK of that monster until the End Phase.

flamvellcommando.name: Flamvell Commando
flamvellcommando.desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card can only be Normal Summoned by Tributing 1 "Flamvell" monster you control. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 monster in your Graveyard with 200 DEF to inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's ATK.

flowercardianlightflare.name: Flower Cardian Lightflare
flowercardianlightflare.desc:
1 Tuner + 4 non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If a "Flower Cardian" monster you control battles an opponent's monster, that opponent's monster has its effects negated during the Battle Phase only. If this face-up Synchro Summoned card is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect while its owner controls it: You can Special Summon 1 "Flower Cardian" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck, except "Flower Cardian Lightflare".

goblindecoysquad.name: Goblin Decoy Squad
goblindecoysquad.desc: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can draw 1 card. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

goldenhomunculus.name: Golden Homunculus
goldenhomunculus.desc: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each of your banished cards.

humanoidslime.name: Humanoid Slime
humanoidslime.desc: This slime apparently has some human genes in its genetic makeup.

hundredeyesdragon.name: Hundred Eyes Dragon
hundredeyesdragon.desc:
1 DARK Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner Fiend-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can banish 1 Level 6 or lower DARK Effect Monster from your Graveyard; until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that banished monster's, and replace this effect with that banished monster's original effects. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster from your Deck to your hand.

ljosalfofthenordicalfar.name: Ljosalf of the Nordic Alfar
ljosalfofthenordicalfar.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster you control, except this card; Special Summon 1 "Nordic" monster from your hand with a Level less than or equal to that face-up monster's Level.

naturesreflection.name: Nature's Reflection
naturesreflection.desc: During this turn, any effect activated by your opponent that would inflict damage becomes an effect that inflicts damage to their Life Points.

ninaruruthemagistusglassgoddess.name: Ninaruru, the Magistus Glass Goddess
ninaruruthemagistusglassgoddess.desc:
2 Level 4 Spellcaster monsters
While this card is an Equip Card, the equipped monster can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ninaruru, the Magistus Glass Goddess" once per turn. You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 Level 4 or higher Spellcaster monster in your GY; add it to your hand. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can target 1 "Magistus" card in your Spell & Trap Zone and 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy them.

nordicbeasttoken.name: Nordic Beast Token
nordicbeasttoken.desc: Special Summoned with the effect of "Tanngrisnir of the Nordic Beasts".

nuviathewicked.name: Nuvia the Wicked
nuviathewicked.desc: If this monster is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls any monster, decrease the ATK of this card by 200 points for each monster on your opponents side of the field.

performapalcelestialmagician.name: Performapal Celestial Magician
performapalcelestialmagician.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
When exactly 1 face-up Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster you control that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck is destroyed by battle, or an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon that destroyed monster, then destroy this card. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Celestial Magician" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can apply the following effect(s) for the rest of this turn, based on the other monsters you currently control.
● Fusion: This card can attack directly.
● Synchro: Your opponent cannot activate monster effects.
● Xyz: This card's ATK becomes double its original ATK.
● Pendulum: During the End Phase, add 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "Performapal Celestial Magician" once per turn.

regenesiscode.name: Regenesis Code
regenesiscode.desc: Special Summon 1 "Regenesis" monster from your Deck (but send it to the GY during your opponent's End Phase), also until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it, then target 1 of your banished "Regenesis" monsters; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Regenesis Code" once per turn.

secretvillageofthespellcasters.name: Secret Village of the Spellcasters
secretvillageofthespellcasters.desc: If only you control a Spellcaster monster, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards. If you control no Spellcaster monsters, you cannot activate Spell Cards.

sforcelapcewell.name: S-Force Lapcewell
sforcelapcewell.desc: If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "S-Force" monster in your GY, except "S-Force Lapcewell"; Special Summon it. You can banish 1 "S-Force" card from your hand; destroy all of your opponent's monsters in the same columns as your "S-Force" monsters. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Lapcewell" once per turn.

sixstriketripleimpact.name: Six Strike - Triple Impact
sixstriketripleimpact.desc:
If you control 3 or more face-up "Six Samurai" monsters, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.
● Destroy all face-up Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls.
● Destroy all Set Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls.

soulstrike.name: Soul Strike
soulstrike.desc: If your LP is 4000 or less, when an attack is declared involving a monster you control and an opponent's monster: Pay half your LP, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the deficit between your current LP and 4000 until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only activate 1 "Soul Strike" per turn.

supayduskwalker.name: Supay, Duskwalker
supayduskwalker.desc: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 "Supay" from your hand or Deck. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Supay, Duskwalker" once per turn.

thelittleswordsmanofaile.name: The Little Swordsman of Aile
thelittleswordsmanofaile.desc: Offer 1 monster on your side of the field as a Tribute to increase this monster's ATK by 700 points until the end of the turn.

thesixshinobi.name: The Six Shinobi
thesixshinobi.desc: If you control 6 "Six Samurai" monsters with different Attributes: Skip your opponent's next turn.

uraby.name: Uraby
uraby.desc: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

witchcrafterpupils.name: Witchcrafter Pupils
witchcrafterpupils.desc:
1 "Witchcrafter" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
During the Main or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell from your Deck to your hand.
● Reveal 1 "Witchcrafter" Normal or Quick-Play Spell in your hand; apply that Spell's activation effect.
During your End Phase: You can return 1 of your banished "Witchcrafter" cards to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Pupils" once per turn.

yummysurprise.name: Yummy☆Surprise
yummysurprise.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Yummy☆Surprise" once per turn);
● Target 2 LIGHT Beast monsters you control and 2 cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand.
● Special Summon 1 "Yummy" monster from your hand or GY, but it cannot attack directly this turn.
● Return 1 Field Spell from your face-up field or GY to the hand, then you can place 1 "Yummy" Field Spell from your hand, face-up on your field.

zeradiasheraldofheaven.name: Zeradias, Herald of Heaven
zeradiasheraldofheaven.desc: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "The Sanctuary in the Sky" from your Deck to your hand. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on the field, destroy this card.
